prior_diagnostic_authority.finding: Local balance residual rates worsen as dt decreases while dt times residual stays approximately 1e-16 to 1e-15 cm; increasing nonlinear iterations from 16 to 64 cleared none of 103 local-balance failures.

purpose: Test whether P2E18 loss of Reference-route validity under timestep refinement is caused by holding a rate-unit balance convergence criterion numerically fixed as dt decreases, by comparing that frozen policy with a dimensionally timestep-invariant integrated-balance policy on the identical 36-case six-level Reference-only matrix.
scientific_question: Does preserving one integrated balance allowance per substep, rather than one fixed cm/day tolerance across all substep durations, recover Reference-route refinement usability without materially changing valid Reference endpoints?

INTEGRATED_INVARIANT.meaning: Keep the maximum allowed integrated balance defect per substep numerically invariant as dt changes. This is a diagnostic numerical policy, not a production tolerance change.

frozen_p2e18_reproduction.rule: The FIXED_RATE arm must reproduce P2E18 before the INTEGRATED_INVARIANT comparison is interpreted.

endpoint_neutrality_budget.purpose: Where both policies produce valid endpoints at the same refinement level, quantify whether scaling the convergence criterion materially changes the accepted solution.
endpoint_neutrality_budget.head_theta_budget: 0.10 times the exact-Se P2E14 Reference-only threshold, matching the already frozen P2E18 reference-stability scale.
endpoint_neutrality_budget.storage_budget: the full exact-Se P2E14 machine-scale storage envelope
endpoint_neutrality_budget.interpretation: A neutrality failure is retained. It prevents describing the scaled policy as a numerically equivalent convergence reformulation at that level.

scaled_fine_stability_diagnostic.budgets: same P2E18 0.10 x P2E14 head/theta budgets plus P2E14 storage floor
scaled_fine_stability_diagnostic.nonclaim: Even if all cases pass, P2E19 does not itself create REF-HIGH. A separate preregistered decision/construction workunit is required.

primary_endpoints: Reference route validity by policy and refinement level
first invalid refinement level per case and policy
endpoint difference between policies where both are valid
scaled-policy 8-vs-16 and 16-vs-32 endpoint stability where available
maximum typed integrated mass residual per accepted substep

hypotheses.H_scaling_causal: If fixed rate-unit balance criteria cause the refinement collapse, INTEGRATED_INVARIANT should recover materially more valid fine-level Reference routes than FIXED_RATE while all non-balance controls remain identical.
hypotheses.H_endpoint_neutrality: Where both policies converge at the same level, endpoint differences remain inside the frozen P2E18 reference-stability budget.
hypotheses.H_ref_high_feasibility: If INTEGRATED_INVARIANT yields valid 8/16/32 levels and both fine endpoint comparisons meet the frozen stability budget for a non-empty case set, a later separately frozen REF-HIGH construction is scientifically feasible on that set.

outcome_policy.if_scaled_recovers_fine_levels: Persist causal diagnostic evidence and require a new preregistered REF-HIGH construction using any proposed scaled policy. Do not reuse P2E19 as the REF-HIGH authority.
outcome_policy.if_scaled_does_not_recover: Retain P2E18 blockage and investigate another candidate-independent Reference strategy. Do not start RossFast timing.
outcome_policy.if_endpoint_neutrality_fails: Do not describe scaling as a pure convergence-policy repair; retain the scientific endpoint effect explicitly.

next_permitted_action: Implement and execute only the two-policy Reference-only six-level diagnostic. RossFast and timing remain forbidden.
